title: Setup → Email and SMS: Send test has nowhere to enter a recipient, and Email saves with its required fields empty
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-18** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Email (`/settings/mail`), SMS Delivery (`/settings/sms`).
- **Actual:** Send test email → 400 "Provide a "to" address (or set from_email)." — the page has no "to" field; it then sends to *From email*. Send test SMS → 400 "Provide a valid "to" phone number (E.164 recommended)." — no field. Email *Save changes* with *Host\** and *From email\** empty → 200 "Settings saved" (Branding refuses a blank required field).
- **Evidence:** [`27-config-email-send-test-result.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/27-config-email-send-test-result.png), [`22-config-settings-sms-test.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/22-config-settings-sms-test.png), [`27-config-email.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/27-config-email.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every admin configuring mail or SMS.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `service-settings` (mail, sms namespaces) / `plugin-email`, `service-sms`.
- **Dedupe words:** send test email recipient, required settings not enforced.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `service-settings`, the mail and sms manifests.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 1 hit in objectstack, 0 in objectui. Related: objectui#13145 (open), where clearing a saved value is refused with "Host is required", which is the opposite edge of the same required-field rule. **New.**
